channel.title: Trump, Family & Administration — Investment Mention Tracker (Admin only)
channel.description: Every sourced stock, fund and crypto mention by Trump administration officials, with how the asset did against the S&P 500. Public data only; no wrongdoing alleged.

item.title: Howard Lutnick (Commerce Sec.) on First Solar (FSLR): Company praise
item.description:
Howard Lutnick (Commerce Sec.) (Admin) mentioned First Solar (FSLR) on 2026-10-28 at 17:46 ET.
Quote: "First Solar is winning in America because they've invented their own technology, they're building their own technology, and they're building it in South Carolina. It's exceptional American technology produced by great American workers. That's what we're driving for, and that's why we're here today." (Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, First Solar release); at the event: "We love natural gas, we love oil, we love solar, we love coal also" (WLOS)
Versus the S&P 500: +0.6% on the comment day, +0.4% to date.
Source: https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/first-solar-inaugurates-first-phase-south-carolina-production-facility-2026-10-28
Public statements and market data only; no wrongdoing is alleged. Not financial advice.
